logo.prompt_final: Modern, clean, friendly and accessible visual style for an inclusive communication app for Deaf people who use Mexican Sign Language. Color palette: deep navy #0F1724, teal #2EC4B6, violet #7C5CFF, coral #FF6B6B, warm amber #FFC857. High quality, crisp, professional product design. Minimal modern app icon for a sign language communication app. A stylized open human hand making a gentle sign gesture, merged with a rounded speech bubble shape behind it. Flat vector illustration made of smooth geometric shapes, soft gradient from teal #2EC4B6 to violet #7C5CFF, one small warm amber #FFC857 accent dot. Perfectly centered, the symbol fills about 70% of the canvas, generous padding, plain solid pure white background, no shadow on the background. Clean crisp edges, balanced and iconic, works at small sizes. No text, no letters.
revision_notas: Una sola figura centrada sobre fondo blanco liso, sin texto: cumple.
Mano con 5 dedos (4 dedos y el pulgar): cumple, aunque los dedos se marcan con líneas finas del degradado y se ven algo irregulares.
El símbolo ocupa cerca del 50 % del lienzo, no el 70 % pedido: se puede recortar el margen al integrarlo.

iconos.prompt_final: Modern, clean, friendly and accessible visual style for an inclusive communication app for Deaf people who use Mexican Sign Language. Color palette: deep navy #0F1724, teal #2EC4B6, violet #7C5CFF, coral #FF6B6B, warm amber #FFC857. High quality, crisp, professional product design. A sprite sheet of 20 user interface icons arranged in a perfectly regular grid of 5 columns and 4 rows, every icon centered in its own equal square cell with lots of empty space around it, all icons the same visual size. Style: consistent minimalist line icons like the Lucide or Feather icon sets, solid pure black strokes of uniform thickness with rounded line caps, on a plain solid pure white background, no grid lines, no borders, no shadows, no color, no text, no labels. Row 1, left to right: an open human hand with three short motion lines (sign language); a webcam; a person bust with a small four-point sparkle (avatar); a speech bubble containing three horizontal lines (subtitles); a microphone. Row 2: a speaker with two sound waves; a speaker with a small x (muted); a record button (filled circle inside a ring); a stop button (rounded square); a play button (triangle). Row 3: an undo curved arrow; a trash can; a brain with a small sparkle (train model); a database cylinder; a bar chart. Row 4: a gear (settings); a question mark inside a circle (help); four arrows pointing to the corners (fullscreen); a person silhouette with a small plus sign (add person); a house (home).
revision_notas: 20 íconos en 5 columnas × 4 filas, en el orden pedido, negros de línea sobre blanco y sin texto: cumple.
Tamaño real 1152×928 (el modelo entrega 1K más grande en 5:4); la proporción coincide.
Las celdas no son milimétricas: comprobar el corte en celdas iguales al integrarla.

ilustraciones.prompt_final: Modern, clean, friendly and accessible visual style for an inclusive communication app for Deaf people who use Mexican Sign Language. Color palette: deep navy #0F1724, teal #2EC4B6, violet #7C5CFF, coral #FF6B6B, warm amber #FFC857. High quality, crisp, professional product design. Four spot illustrations arranged in a perfectly regular 2 by 2 grid, each one centered in its own equal quadrant with generous empty margins, all in exactly the same flat vector style with soft rounded shapes, limited palette of teal #2EC4B6, violet #7C5CFF, coral #FF6B6B, warm amber #FFC857 and navy #0F1724, on a plain solid pure white background, no grid lines, no borders, no text. Top left: two diverse young Mexican adults in friendly conversation, one signing with both hands, the other listening and smiling, a small friendly 3D-style avatar character between them waving. Top right: a person seated at a desk facing a laptop webcam, upper body visible from head to waist including both elbows, with a dashed rounded rectangle guide framing the head, shoulders and elbows. Bottom left: a webcam with a soft diagonal slash and a small question mark, meaning camera not found. Bottom right: a stylized open hand made of connected dots and lines like motion-tracking landmarks, next to a small progress bar, meaning training. Hands drawn simply and correctly with five fingers.
revision_notas: 4 ilustraciones en 2 × 2, mismo estilo, fondo blanco, sin texto: cumple.

Arriba a la derecha: la guía punteada no enmarca bien cabeza, hombros y codos; queda como un rectángulo partido con un recuadro aparte en un codo, y la persona saluda en lugar de estar frente a la cámara con los codos visibles.
Arriba a la izquierda: el avatar es una criatura tipo mascota, no un personaje 3D, y está abajo, no entre los dos.
Manos: en general tienen 5 dedos; la mano de puntos (abajo a la derecha) también.

costo_total_nota: La API no informó el costo. Precio publicado: 0.04 USD por imagen a 1K, unos 0.20 USD en total.
